content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on a project that involves using an ESP32 with a [product_name] controller from [company_name], connected via WiFi. The ESP32 is linked through a WLAN 1100 device by Phoenix Contact. I am aiming to read distance measurements using a VL53L0X laser sensor. The goal is to transfer this data using MODBUS TCP protocol to the [product_name] controller. Here is my progress so far: **MODBUS POLL CONNECTED TO ESP32** [url] Read input registers [url] Currently, I can view the value in Modbus Poll. My question is, how does the [product_name] controller read this value? Specifically, how should I configure the parameters based on the information from Modbus Poll and the settings of the controller? [url] [url]
Thread closed because the same question was posted twice. The second post titled ESP32 and [product_name] controller MODBUS was published in the Modbus/TCP conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is trying to integrate an ESP32 microcontroller with a [product_name] controller from [company_name] over MODBUS TCP using a WLAN 1100 device and a VL53L0X laser distance sensor. The main issue is setting up the [product_name] controller so it can accurately read data sent by the ESP32 over MODBUS TCP, with particular uncertainty around parameter configuration and data mapping between the MODBUS Poll tool, the ESP32, and the controller’s settings.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to correctly set up the [product_name] controller from [company_name] to read data from the ESP32 over MODBUS TCP, matching what is observed in MODBUS Poll. They expect clear guidance on mapping and configuring parameters for smooth communication between devices.
